rawRecord.short_description: Multi-agent pipeline combining A2A protocol, Google ADK, and MCP for secure database query processing with PII masking.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Demonstrates a multi-agent security pipeline where three specialized agents collaborate: one validates input for SQL injection and threats, another executes natural language database queries, and a third identifies and masks personally identifiable information in results. Combines Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication protocol, and MCP database tools into a single orchestrated workflow with a built-in web UI.
